origin.source: LangGraph chat bot evaluation as multi-agent simulation

comparison.purpose: A chatbot and simulated user alternate under a turn bound, then an independent evaluator scores the transcript. LangSmith dataset and experiment services are intentionally omitted.

starters.scenario: A frustrated customer wants a refund for a delayed order.
starters.opening: Hi, I need to talk to someone about my late package.

starters.scenario: A curious user asks about upgrading their subscription plan.
starters.opening: Can you tell me what the Pro plan includes?
